text:
elaine (People Ops): @omar FYI — Nina in Platform flagged her paycheck for 06/15: she moved from TX to NJ as an internal transfer effective 06/05 but state tax was still taken for TX (which is zero). Can payroll confirm what jurisdiction was used and whether we can refund the NJ withholding?

omar (Payroll): Can you paste the redacted stub or last4 so I can pull the run?

nina (Eng): Redacted snippet from DM: 
```
Pay period: 06/01/2026-06/15/2026
Base pay: $6,000.00
Transfer pay adjustment: $0.00
State tax (TX): $0.00
State tax (NJ withheld): $420.00
Net: $4,980.00
```
Employee: Nina Park, EmpID 51288, last4 5544. I updated my home address and manager moved my assignment in Workday on 06/04.

omar (Payroll): @payroll-bot fetch payrun EmpID 51288 period 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-15 and show resident state flag.

payroll-bot: Pulling payrun... Found record. Payroll profile resident_state = TX (stale). Workday change to NJ arrived after HRIS cutoff, so payroll used TX for jurisdiction but payroll engine applied a NJ withholding override (manual legacy rule) on top of TX zeros — net effect: NJ tax was withheld but YTD state residency remained TX. Creating ticket PAY-7110 for residency sync and refund processing.

elaine (People Ops): So payroll used mixed signals and ended up withholding NJ even though payroll residency stayed TX? That explains mismatch.

omar (Payroll): Exactly. Two issues: 1) HRIS-to-payroll sync missed before cut, leaving resident_state stale; 2) a downstream rule applied a one-off NJ withholding because of the transfer export. We'll reverse the incorrect NJ withholding and update resident_state. Off-cycle refund can be processed without employee consent for system errors. ETA 2 business days for reversal and ledger update.

nina (Eng): Thanks. Will the reversal show as a separate deposit or as an adjustment on next paycheck? I have rent due next week.

omar (Payroll): We can issue either an immediate off-cycle payment (refund) or apply to next cycle. Since this is a payroll error and you need funds, we can prioritize an off-cycle refund. It will appear as a separate deposit with description "State withholding correction - PAY-7110." Please confirm your bank account on file.

elaine (People Ops): Also: will this change state allocation on Nina's W-2? We need to ensure year-end reporting matches residency.

omar (Payroll): Yes, once we update resident_state to NJ in payroll and reverse the incorrect entries, YTD will reflect NJ residency and withholdings. The W-2 feed will receive the corrected state totals. Ticket PAY-7110 will include an audit trail for W-2 mapping.

h ris-bot: HRIS sync log: Workday change for Nina (EmpID 51288) processed 2026-06-04 17:12Z, arrived to payroll queue 2026-06-06 02:05Z (after payroll cutoff 2026-06-05 23:59Z).

elaine (People Ops): Noted. I'll follow up with Nina's manager to remind about cutoff. @omar please cc me and nina on ticket updates and confirm when off-cycle refund is scheduled.

omar (Payroll): Will do. Marking PAY-7110 priority. Nina, please DM me bank confirmation and I'll attach.

nina (Eng): DMing now, thanks everyone. Appreciate the fast help. :pray:

(reacts: :thumbsup: from elaine, :eyes: from omar)
